feedback: Multiple semantic-fidelity problems. (1) Task semantics: the objective is to reach the exit WHILE carrying the box; the machine pays 1.0 for (u0, holding_box & at_exit, u4) correctly, but several paths give positive reward for exiting WITHOUT the box or after a fall was not immediately fixed. (u3, at_exit, u1) gives +0.05 when the agent reaches the exit with empty hands (after having held the box) — that contradicts 'get to the exit carrying the box'. Likewise (u1, at_exit, u1) and (u2, at_exit, u2) give +0.05 for exiting while the box is on the floor, rewarding task failure. Exits without holding_box must yield 0 (or negative) reward, not +0.05. (2) Task requirement 'every time the box falls, your very next move must pick it up again' is not encoded: u1 -> u3 on holding_box is evaluated at the NEXT proposition reading, and since box_fell and holding_box never co-occur, a one-step-later pickup is indistinguishable from a delayed pickup (e.g., picking up at step+5 also satisfies (u1, holding_box) -> u3 with +0.2); the machine cannot enforce 'immediately next move' and its rewards make delayed pickups just as good. If immediacy is required, the transition out of u1 on holding_box should give reduced/no reward unless the pickup is immediate — but with predicate-only per-step events and no 'picked_up' event proposition, immediacy cannot be expressed; the machine should at minimum not reward the fall itself (0.05 for box_fell is rewarding failure) and should penalize steps in u1/u2 without holding_box, which it does (-0.1), partially addressing it. Still, the +0.05 fall reward is wrong. (3) The 'else' self-loops in u1/u2 give -0.1 per step, but an episode can legitimately pass through u1->u2 if the agent never picked the box up again — fine — yet reaching at_exit from u1/u2 keeps the machine out of FINAL and terminates with no terminal signal difference; the reward for exit-without-box being positive (+0.05) is the main issue. (4) FINAL_STATES u4 is declared and reachable; (u4, else) -> u4 self-loop exists, good. (5) Missing coverage: siren_ringing and switch_toggled never appear; that is fine because the task does not involve the siren, and they fall under else self-loops. (6) Boundedness: rewards bounded, dense progress via +0.2 pickup — acceptable. Overall: fix the exit rewards to be 0/negative unless holding_box at exit, and remove the +0.05 reward for box_fell (falling is a failure event per the task).

feedback: Semantic problems: (1) The task requires that after every box_fell the very next move is a pickup. The RM transitions (u1, box_fell)->u2 and (u2, holding_box)->u1 accept any later recovery, not the immediate next move; holding_box is not detected on the pickup step only via box_fell, and no state encodes 'fell and not yet recovered exactly next step'. There is no regression/drop-penalty for dropping the box either. (2) (u2, at_exit)->u2 with reward -0.5 fires when reaching the exit without the box (holding_box false), penalizing exit without the box — but per-state self-loop 'else' also covers at_exit in u2, so the explicit (u2, holding_box & at_exit)->u3 ignores that at_exit alone in u2 goes to self-loop with -0.5 each step; ok there. However in u0, (u0, holding_box & at_exit)->u3 is declared but no reward entry exists for it — missing reward for (u0, holding_box, u3) transition. Also (u2, else, u2)->-0.05 makes the machine give negative dense reward in u2 for any step including steps after a fall not yet recovered — but that is fine. (3) Critical flaw: box_fell and holding_box never hold together, and box_fell & at_exit never co-occur, but (u1, box_fell)->u2 means after a fall the machine can only reach u3 via (u2, holding_box & at_exit); if the agent picks up the box and then steps to exit, that works — but if the agent picks up the box mid-room (holding_box true, not at exit), it goes to u1, then box_fell again ->u2: fine. (4) Reward safety/density: reaching exit with box gives 1.0, but the (u0, holding_box & at_exit)->u3 transition has no listed reward (assumed 0?), inconsistent with (u2, holding_box & at_exit)->1.0. Also no reward listed for (u1, holding_box & at_exit) in a step where box_fell also... impossible, fine. (5) The machine does not distinguish immediate next-move pickup: agent could take 50 steps after a fall before picking up and still get full 1.0 reward. This fails ordered-transition coverage for the stated task 'every time the box falls, your very next move must pick it up again'. Add a dedicated post-fall state that only transitions out on the immediately following holding_box, penalizing any other step.
